author: Cinna Davis with OpenAI Codex
statement: The source Tanner initial sparse-check matrix can be constructed deterministically in time polynomial in n, m and numeric B by conditional-expectation Walsh shifts and a Vandermonde local code, retaining the source row and distance parameters. This changes preprocessing only and does not improve the selected SAT bound.
remaining_obligations: Independent review of the source-parameter inequalities and all-size bit-complexity argument
Replay the q>1 Tanner matrix construction with full source parameters
No improved alpha or full SAT algorithm is claimed
